question: What textual section concludes with the rules on liṅga and temple construction in this work?
premises: The text is identified as Aṃśumān Kāśyapa
A chapter on liṅga and temple is completed
inference: The ninety-fifth chapter on liṅga and temple concludes in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the ninety-fifth chapter on the liṅga and the temple in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
